auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/9/4), with 5 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 9 · Craft 9 · Talk 19 · Explore 39 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Sofia Chen ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
